notes.title: Patch update 6.94
notes.content:
VERY SOON AVAILABLE!

We release within a few days the new update 6.94.

See below its content:

-Correction on the collapse of the healthcare system and the drop of life expectancy
-Correction for electricity consumption trends in certain countries
-Adjustment to the calculation of the EU Parliament's vote in the case of an application for membership
-Correction on the allocation of annexed regions in the peace treaty and in the Modding Tool
-Update of net migration and number of foreigners in Portugal
-Correction of a freeze due to a very high 5G coverage rate
-Adjustments to the calculation of the evolution of informal employment
-Correction of infinite state budgets during long lasting games
-Dutch parliamentary elections with proportional representation
-"Parliamentary monarchy" option added in the Modding Tool
-Adjustment of economic growth following the development of an open sector after a scientific discovery
-Number of Ukrainian fighters aircrafts updated to 01/01/2023
-Correction of blocked recurring budget cost during long lasting games
-Correction of negative energy consumption after annexing another country
-Addition of various skins for military units in the Modding Tool
-Location of South Ukraine nuclear base
-Correction following breaking a contract with a paramilitary organization
-Internet development campain promise taken into account
-Correction of cities destruction level when loading a mod
-Correction of religious group nomination in modding tool
-Extension of the number of accepted refugee to all refugee camps
-Correction of manual modification of the number of soldiers in a city battle
-Update of the political tendency of the ruling party in Slovenia
-Correction of the God'n'Spy’s conspiracy theories panel
-Correction when the player changes their political party while in a monarchical regime
-Modification of the number of days required to dismantle a trench in realistic construction time mode
-Correction of war triggering between allies who come to help the same country in a conflict
-Correction when allocating infrastructure on the map after a peace treaty with region annexation
-Addition of the character model of the leader of the ruling party in Russia
-Soldier units in bases can now receive the order to create trenches
-Correction of the display of advertising in the newspaper
-Addition of Cork and Drogheda in Ireland
-Correction to the display of the initial technology level of a military industrial sector
-Corrections to the consequences of low health for the played character 
-Set destruction level for Ukrainian cities
-Display of immigration statistics for countries with no foreign communities
-Correction on basic construction without taking into account labor and accelerated construction
-Modification of the legend of the number of AIDS deaths per year chart
-Correction on successive government overthrows in regions that have gained independence
-Soldier units can now receive the order to create trenches from the advanced interface
-Correction of the TV speech for the Acquisition of Greenland and Annexation of Greenland scenarios
-Miscellaneous corrections


We would like to thank the entire community and beta testers for their collaboration in improving the game.

notes.title: Patch update 6.93 and Modding Tool DLC released
notes.content:
The Modding Tool DLC is now available.
And we've just released the 6.93 update. See below its content:

-Correction of NaN values in country budgets
-Modification of the algorithm for changing the ECB's key interest rate and its display in the countries concerned
-Unblocking of fighter aircraft carrier assignments
-Possibility of adjusting staffing levels in the nationalized fuel sector in the event of zero production
-Removal of demining move decisions if unit moves are under the exclusive control of the player-head of state
-German parliament seats updated
-Updated regional capitals for certain countries (Spain, Italy...)
-Removal of severance pay when recruiting commandos
-Acquisition of foreign armies when acquiring territories
-Modification of location and/or addition of cities in Italy, Germany (including Koblenz), Albania, Jordan
-Authorization for war refugees to return home after the end of the war, even if their city has not been rebuilt.
-Correction on the restarting of conflict after a peace treaty
-Correction on tax reform integrating income tax
-Update on the new name of Kazakhstan's capital Astana
-Correction on the allocation of trenches after the end of the war
-Correction on allocation of Russian naval bases in Crimea after the end of the war
-Modification of location and population for some Russian cities
-Rice consumption correction for certain countries (Bangladesh, North Korea...)
-Addition of certain civilian airports around the world
-Correction of unemployment rate at end of war and after demobilization
-Italian military equipment industries updated
-Corrected calculation of changes in foreign communities as a function of immigration
-Majority privatization of the lottery and betting sector in France
-Corrections to some Italian translations
-Corrections to some % of parties in Italian elections
-Numerous Turkish data updated (minimum social benefits, etc.)
-More activists added when player changes political party
-Updated political leanings of regional presidents in France
-Corrected commando hiring
-Possibility of resetting a grant to 0
-Modification of requests for return of an immigration agreement with reinforced border surveillance
-Adjustment to currency parity calculations
-Possibility of dismantling paramilitary and mercenary camps after the end of the war
-Correction to military satellite mergers
-Adjustment to conditions for returning war refugees
-Correction of pause key operation with space bar in advanced interface
-Possibility of dismantling mercenary camps
-Correction to delivery of land armaments to land bases
-Adjustment of CO2 impacts following civil airport construction
-Correction of riot evolution in an AI country
-Adjustments to delivery times for certain military equipment in "realistic duration" game mode
-Correction to the possibility of sending troops to cantonment bases shared between countries
-Correction to the display of the causes of death graph after a change of year
-Miscellaneous corrections

We would like to thank the entire community and beta testers for their collaboration in improving the game.
